paite: Tempul a kipan Jesu pawtkhia a, apai lai in, anungzuite tempul ensak ding in akiang ah hong pai uhi.
heading: Tempul Siatna Leh Hun Tawp Genkholhna / (Mar 13.1-2; Luk 21.5-6)
english: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

paite: Himahleh ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai tengteng na mu uh maw? Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hihchip louh a suang kichiang hiai ah a-om kei ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”

paite: Olive tang a atut lai in nungzuite amau kia in akiang ah ahong ua, "Huaite chikchiang in ahong om dia? Na hong pai nawnna leh khovel tawpna ding chiamtehna bang ahi dia? hon hilh in," achi uhi.
heading: Buaina Leh Gawtnate / (Mar 13.3-13; Luk 21.5-6)
english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”

paite: Jesu'n amau adawng a, "Kuamah hon khemzohlouhna ding in pilvang un.
english: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

paite: Mi tampi'n, 'Khrist ka hi, chi in keimah min lou in ahong pai ding uh; mi tampi akhemzoh ding ziak un.'
english: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.

paite: Huan kidou thu leh kidou thuthang na za ding ua; na mangbatlouhna ding un pilvang un; huaite ahong om ding him ahi; himahleh tawpna zaw ahi nai tadih kei ding hi.
english: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.

paite: Nam tuam leh nam tuam akidou ding ua, gam tuam leh gam tuam akidou ding ua, mun tuamtuam ah kial ake dia, zin aling ding hi.
english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.

paite: Huai tengteng nauvei kipatna ahi.
english: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.

paite: "Huai hun chiang in gimthuak ding in hon mansak ding ua, hon that ding uh. Ka min ziak in nam tengteng huat na hi ding uh.
heading: Soisakna Genkholhna
english: “Then they will deliver you up to oppression and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.

paite: Huai hun chiang in mi tampi apuk ding ua, akimansaktuah ding ua, akihotuah ding uhi.
english: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.

paite: Zawlnei taklou tampi ahong pawt ding ua, mi tampi akhempuk ding uh.
english: Many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.

paite: Huan hihkhelhna apun ding ziak in mi tamzaw itna ahong dai ding hi.
english: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.

paite: Himahleh, atawp tan a thuak ngap peuhmah, huai mi ngei hotdam in a-om ding hi.
english: But he who endures to the end will be saved.

paite: Huan hiai lalgam tanchinhoih nam tengteng theihsakna ding in khovel tengteng ah hilh in a-om ding; huai khit chiang in tawpna ahong tung ding hi.
english: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.

paite: "Huchi in hihmangbangpa kihhuai, zawlnei Daniel gen, mun siangthou a dingh na muh chiang un, asim peuhmah in a-omdan thei hen.
heading: Dipkuatna Mulkimhuai Hun / (Mar 13.14-23; Luk 21.20-24)
english: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),

paite: Judia gam a omte tang sang ah taimang uhen.
english: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

paite: Inn tung a om in a-inn a banghiam la ding in kum kei hen.
english: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.

paite: Huan lou a om inn a puan la ding in kik nawn kei hen.
english: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.

paite: Huai ni'n numei gaite leh naunou pomte tung agik ding hi!
english: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!

paite: Na taimang hun ding uh phalbi lai hiam, Sabbath ni hiam a ahong tunlouhna ding in thum un.
english: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath,

paite: Huai hun chiang in gimthuakna thupi a-om ding ziak in, hichibang a thupi leilung pian tung a kipan tutan in a-om ngei nai kei a, chik mah chiang in ahong om nawn sam kei ding.
english: for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.

paite: Huai nite hihtom hi keileh mihing dam in apawt kei ding uh; himahleh, telte ziak in huai nite hihtom ahi ding hi.
english: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.

paite: "Huai hun chiang in kuapeuh in na kiang ua, 'En dih, Khrist hiai ah hiam, huai ah hiam,' achih uleh, gingta kei un.
english: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘There!’ don’t believe it.

paite: Khrist taklou leh zawlnei takloute ahong pawt ding ziak un, huaite'n hi thei liaileh telte nangawn leng akhempuk theihna ding un chiamtehna leh thillamdang thupitakte ahih ding uhi.
english: For false christs and false prophets will arise, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

paite: Ngai un, ka hon hilhkhol khinta hi.
english: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.

paite: "Huchi in na kiang uah, 'ngai un, gamdai ah a-om' hon chih uleh, 'paikhe kei un; dantan sunggil ah a-om, hon chih uleh, taksang sam kei un'.
english: “If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; or ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.

paite: Khua, suahlam a ahong phiat a, tumlam tan a akilat zel bang in, Mihing Tapa ahong pai nawnna huchibang ahi ding hi.
english: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

paite: "Siluang omna mun peuh ah musanete leng a-omkhawm ding uh.
english: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.

paite: "Himahleh huai gimthuakna nite nung zek in, ni hihmial in a-om ding a, kha avak nawnta kei dia, van a kipan aksite ahong ke ding ua, van thilhihtheihnate hihlin in a-om ding uh.
heading: Mihing Tapa Hong Paina / (Mar 13.24-27; Luk 21.25-28)
english: “But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;

paite: Huai hun chiang in van ah Mihing Tapa chiamtehna ahong lang ding a, huai hun chiang in leitung a nam tengteng in asuun ding ua, 'Mihing Tapa thilhihtheihna leh thupina lian toh van meipi tung a hong pai amu ding uh.'
english: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.

paite: Huan a-angelte pengkul ging thupi toh asawlkhe ding a, amau atelte lei ning lite a kipan, van tawp a kipan alehlam tawp pha in akaikhawm ding uh.
english: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.

paite: "Huchi in theipi kung ah gentehna thu zil un; ahiang ahong nou a, anah ahong sel in nipi anai chih na thei uh.
heading: Theipi Kung A Pan Sinlai / (Mar 3.28-31; Luk 21.29-33)
english: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable: When its branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.

paite: Huchi mah bang in nou leng huai tengteng na muh chiang un, amah ahong naita a, kongkhak bul ah a-om chih thei un.
english: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that he is near, even at the doors.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, huai tengteng atunkim masiah hiai khang amang kei ding.
english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things are accomplished.

paite: Lei leh van amang dia, ka thu ahihleh amang kei ding hi.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

paite: "Himahleh, huai ni leh hun thu Pa kia lou ngal kuamah in, van a angelte'n leng, Tapa in leng athei kei uh.
heading: Kiveng Gige A Om Poimohna / (Mar 13.32-37; Luk 17.26-30; 17.34-36)
english: “But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

paite: Noah dam lai bang in Mihing Tapa hong pai nawnna ah ahi ding.
english: As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

paite: Huai ni, tuichim tun ma in, long a Noah alut ni tan in, ane un adawn ua, zi leh pasal in akinei ua;
english: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,

paite: tuichim ahong tung a, avek ua alakmang masiah bangmah athei kei uh; Mihing Tapa hong pai nawnna huchi mah bang ahi ding.
english: and they didn’t know until the flood came and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

paite: Huai hun chiang in lou ah mi nih a-om ding ua; khat paimangpih in a-om dia, khat nutsiat in a-om ding.
english: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.

paite: Numei nih buh gawinelna ah buh gawinel in a-om ding ua, khat paimangpih in a-om dia, khat nutsiat in a-om ding hi.
english: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.

paite: "Huaiziak in kiging un, bang ni'n ahia na Toupa uh ahong pai ding na theih louh ziak un.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.

paite: Himahleh, hiai thei un, guta hong pai hun ding inn neitu in theileh, aveng ding a, a-inn aphenvangsak kei ding hi.
english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

paite: Huaiziak in nou leng kiging gige in om un, na gin louh dak ua Mihing Tapa ahong pai ding ziak in.
english: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.

paite: "Sikha muanhuai, piltak, apu'n ahun teng a atan ding uh hawmsak ding a a-inkuanpihte tung a heutu dia akoih, kua pen ahi dia le?
heading: Sikha Hoih Leh Hoih Lou Gentehna / (Luk 12.41-48)
english: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?

paite: Apu hong pai chiang in sikha huchibang hih a amuh pen ahampha ding hi.
english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, aneih tengteng tung ah heutu ding in akoih ding hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

paite: Himahleh sikha gilou in alungtang in, ka pu ahong zok kei ding, chi in
english: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’

paite: asikha hihpihte na vua henla, nekham-takhamte kiang ah ne in dawn taleh;
english: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,

paite: huai sikha pu agintak louh ni'n, atheih louh lai in, ahong pai ding a,
english: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,

paite: tum nih asuah ding a, milepchiahte tan bangbang atangsak ding; huai ah kah leh hagawi a-om ding hi."
english: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.
